name: @polaris/archive-replay
description: Replay planner and executor for Polaris. The planner is a pure function that turns a replay-job declaration into a deterministic plan (source topic, scope, time window, target processor/consumer/version, destination policy, risk flags, consumer group). The executor consumes a plan and orchestrates the run via injected source/producer/store adapters, stamping the platform replay headers so destinations can apply the P7-004 guardrails.
